summary: Madison County Aermotor lookout erected 1948 for the NC Division of Forest Resources; removed 2009, and no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: The lookout page says the tower was removed in 2009.
facts.agency: North Carolina Division of Forest Resources

events.note: A 73-foot Aermotor tower with a 7x7 cab was erected.
The lookout page says the tower was removed.

evidence.supports: The lookout is in Madison County.
The lookout page names the North Carolina Division of Forest Resources as the agency.
evidence.quote: North Carolina Division of Forest Resources

evidence.supports: The tower went up in 1948 as a 73-foot Aermotor with a 7x7 cab.
evidence.quote: 1948: A 73-foot Aermotor tower with a 7x7 cab was erected.

evidence.supports: A North Carolina Geodetic Survey station was described in 1981 and recorded as Big Knob Lookout Tower.
evidence.quote: DESCRIBED BY NORTH CAROLINA GEODETIC SURVEY 1981

evidence.supports: The survey station record is titled Big Knob Lookout Tower.
The 1981 directions run south along SR 1346 to a gate where state maintenance ends.
evidence.quote: SOUTH ALONG SR 1346 FOR 2.3 KM (1.45 MI) TO THE END OF STATE

evidence.supports: The 1981 directions name a gate at the end of state road maintenance.
The 1981 directions run along a gravel road to the top of the mountain.
evidence.quote: GRAVELED ROAD TO THE TOP OF THE MOUNTAIN, AND LOOKOUT TOWER.

evidence.supports: A statewide list places Big Knob in Madison County at 35.88694 north and 82.55666 west.

notes_for_editor: Brief status was unknown; the lookout page gives removal in 2009, so status is gone. The 73-foot height matches the brief's 22.3 m (73 ft is about 22.25 m), so no correction. The registers field in the brief lists NGS; the survey record itself is by the North Carolina Geodetic Survey and is a survey station, not a lookout register, so it is not carried into facts. The history rests on a single compiled lookout page, which cites the survey station record. No staffing or fire records were found, and no source describes the site today, so the story says so. No photos found.
